text:
AMD is at all time high, people wonders should they sell their ESPP shares.

They are asking the wrong question.  The real question they should ask themselves is what are they going to do with the money after they sell the shares.

If they want to reward themselves, have a nice vacation or buy a new car, that is a saving or not question

If they want to put it in the bank, park it somewhere safe, that's a will the stock market crash question

If they want to buy some other non-AI stocks, that's an asset allocation diversification question.

If they want to double down, buy some even more bubbly AI names, that's is a YOLO question.
